arm_configuration_source: strict terminal checkpoint manifest only; no CLI arm overrides

native_loader.strategy: same frozen loader code; verified __file__ root only

goal_source.use: provided goal for fixed complete trajectory selection only

dataset_provenance.target: cumulative XY, current ego x-forward y-left, metres, .5..3s

temporal_data.augmentation: same row/epoch front B-C-C factors for current and both history images

causal_status.definition: exact 11 causal pose frames -10..0, nominal 10Hz quadratic fit, current ego XY
causal_status.use: loss-only default; explicit common_status maps solely to perception_status

temporal_data.goal_use: outer sample only; final selector caller must pass separately

model_only_latency.excluded: raw/cache decode, disk/tar I/O, input assembly, H2D, GT/metrics, evaluator route hooks and bank checks
model_only_latency.scope: full temporal model forward: all current/history encodings, perception auxiliaries, base DFA and final goal selector

preprocessing_latency.excluded: H2D, model forward, checkpoint loading, reference/GT reads
preprocessing_latency.note: OS file cache may be warm; this is CPU preprocessing latency, not RTX4090/model latency
preprocessing_latency.scope: disk parquet/image reads, geometry cache lookup, raw undistortion/crop/Q95/resize/normalization, allowed status/goal assembly

route_audit.aux_state_independence: not applicable: common status input absent
